summary: Navigate the complexities of ISO 55001 transition with our expert guidance. Optimize your asset management system and achieve operational excellence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for asset management professionals who need to transition their AMS to ISO 55001:2024 and demonstrate up-to-date compliance expertise.
modules: Introduction to ISO 55001:2024 and Comparison to 2014
prerequisites: There are no formal prerequisites for this course. However, prior experience with ISO 55001:2014 or asset management systems is recommended for maximum benefit.
